description: This file contains a managed implementation of the MD5 hash algorithm, including the MD5Managed class which extends HashAlgorithm and the internal static class MD5Core implementing the MD5 algorithm logic.

classes.name: MD5Managed
classes.description: A managed implementation of the MD5 hash algorithm, necessary for platforms lacking native MD5 support and for FIPS compliance.

classes.name: MD5Core
classes.description: Internal static class implementing the core MD5 algorithm functions, including block processing and final hash computation.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new MD5Managed object.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the MD5 state variables and buffers.

methods.name: HashCore
methods.description: Processes input data in chunks, updating the hash state.

methods.name: HashFinal
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation and returns the hash value.
